items.title: Tawau Port acquires two new dock cranes worth RM70mil
items.summary: TAWAU: The acquisition of two new quay cranes worth RM70 million for Tawau Port is expected to boost port efficiency and strengthen its role as a key maritime gateway on Sabah's east coast. Sabah Chief Minister Datuk Seri Hajiji Noor said the investment is a strategic step to strengthen the state's port infrastructure and support Sabah's long-term economic growth. He noted that the investment also reflects the state government's commitment through Sabah Ports Sdn Bhd (SPSB) to modernise critical infrastructure, enhancing efficiency and competitiveness of Sabah's ports, particularly on the state's east coast.

items.title: Discussions with PN in Melaka won't necessarily result in pact, says BN's Rauf
items.summary: MELAKA: The winning momentum from Barisan Nasional and Perikatan Nasional's understanding in Negri Sembilan will lead to a "BN Plus" arrangement in Melaka, although discussions with PN may not necessarily result in a political pact. Chief Minister Datuk Seri Ab Rauf Yusoh, who is also Melaka BN chairman, said the "BN Plus" formula reflected the state chapter's openness to negotiations with any party. However, he said all decisions would ultimately align with BN's interests and strength in the state.

items.title: South Korea records highest-ever temperature of 42.5°C
items.summary: SEOUL: South Korea registered its highest temperature since records began more than a century ago on Sunday, according to the state weather agency. The southeastern city of Yangsan recorded a temperature of 42.5°C at 1.26pm (0426 GMT), the Korea Meteorological Administration (KMA) said on its website. Yangsan has been the epicentre of the ongoing heatwave, where temperatures exceeded 40°C for a fifth consecutive day on Sunday.

items.title: Chow: PH to review election setbacks, refine strategy
items.summary: BUKIT MERTAJAM: Pakatan Harapan will hold a meeting on Aug 8 to review the causes of its defeats in the Johor and Negri Sembilan state elections and chart a new strategy ahead of the 16th General Election (GE16) and future state polls. Penang PH chairman Chow Kon Yeow said the meeting had been scheduled before the Johor and Negri Sembilan elections as part of the coalition's early preparations should GE16 or state elections be called ahead of schedule. Commenting on the Negri Sembilan election, Chow said the outcome had raised important questions about the country's political direction.

items.title: HLIB starts coverage on MFM with 'Buy' call
items.summary: KUALA LUMPUR: Hong Leong Investment Bank Bhd (HLIB) has initiated coverage on Malayan Flour Mills Bhd (MFM) with a "Buy" rating and a target price of 93 sen. The target price is based on seven times its mid-financial year 2027 core earnings per share (EPS) estimate of 13.3 sen. HLIB said MFM is expected to record a three-year compound annual growth rate of 7.5 per cent in core earnings for financial years 2026 to 2028. It said the earnings growth would be underpinned by improved operating efficiency at MFM's flour milling operations in Malaysia and Vietnam, as well as favourable input cost dynamics.

items.title: Trump says US, Israel to hold off on Iran strikes
items.summary: WASHINGTON: President Donald Trump said on Saturday that the United States and Israel had agreed to hold off on new strikes on Iran, provided a deal to end the months-long conflict is "rapidly" reached. Trump said the US was "locked and loaded and ready to go against the Islamic Republic of Iran", but added that Teheran and other Middle Eastern countries had asked him to hold off on fresh strikes. The US president said the deal would have to include the "Immediate, Complete and Total OPENING OF THE HORMUZ STRAIT, and an end to Iran's nuclear threat".

items.title: Amanah eyes wider political cooperation after Negri poll losses
items.summary: BUKIT MERTAJAM: Amanah will focus on strengthening political cooperation within Pakatan Harapan while exploring broader collaboration with parties that share its commitment to values-based politics. The move comes after the party's performance in the Johor and Negri Sembilan state elections, which Amanah said warrants a comprehensive review. On the Negri Sembilan election, he said Amanah respected the people's mandate and would conduct a thorough post-mortem, including reviewing political cooperation and the party's organisational strength.

items.title: Gesture of appreciation: Negeri Sembilan MB announces special state public holiday tomorrow
items.summary: KUALA PILAH, Aug 2 — Newly sworn-in Negeri Sembilan Menteri Besar Datuk Ismail Lasim today announced a special public holiday for the state tomorrow, saying it is meant to recognise the efforts of those involved in the recently concluded state election. Speaking at his first press conference after taking his oath of office, Ismail said the holiday had received the consent of the Yang di-Pertuan Besar of Negeri Sembilan, Tuanku Muhriz Tuanku Munawir. “His Royal Highness has also graciously consented for me to announce a special public holiday tomorrow for the people of Negeri Sembilan,” he said.

items.title: Nestlé Malaysia expands ready-to-drink coffee range
items.summary: KUALA LUMPUR: Nestle Malaysia Bhd has launched two new Nescafe ready-to-drink (RTD) coffee flavours — Spanish Latte and Tiramisu Latte — as part of its "Treat Yourself to More" campaign aimed at encouraging young Malaysians to celebrate everyday achievements. The new RTD range features Nescafe Spanish Latte, inspired by one of today's popular café beverages with smooth coffee notes and creamy sweetness, and Nescafe Tiramisu Latte, which combines coffee with creamy notes and a hint of cocoa flavour inspired by the classic dessert. Nescafe also collaborated with Cookiecrumbs, offering visitors a "Treat Yourself to More" kit comprising either a Spanish Latte or Tiramisu Latte paired with a Cookiecrumbs cookie.

items.title: Restaurant kitchen fire at Sunway Square Mall put out before firefighters arrive
items.summary: SUBANG JAYA: A fire involving a restaurant kitchen at the lower ground level of Sunway Square Mall in Bandar Sunway was extinguished before firemen arrived at the scene early today. Selangor Fire and Rescue Department operations deputy director Ashrul Riezal Asbar said the department received an emergency call at 1.23am and dispatched personnel from the Subang Jaya Fire and Rescue Station. He said the first fire engine arrived five minutes later and found the blaze had already been put out.

items.title: Teen placed in medically induced coma after crash with RXZ Members 8.0 participant
items.summary: The incident occurred when the motorcycle carrying the teenager and his mother was struck by another motorcycle ridden by a participant of the gathering at the Buluh Gading four-way intersection in Kuala Nerus. The boy was placed in a medically induced coma to enable doctors to carry out procedures to clean and treat his burn wounds. He said although his son briefly regained consciousness on Sunday morning, doctors noted a rapid heart rate, requiring continued close monitoring.

items.title: Man fined RM10,000 for harbouring 2 Myanmar migrants
items.summary: PASIR MAS: The Sessions Court here today fined a man RM10,000 for harbouring two Myanmar undocumented migrants. Judge Zulkpli Abdullah fined Mohd Hilmi Admam, 42, who pleaded guilty to the charge under under Section 55E(1) of the Immigration Act 1959/63. Hilmi paid the fine.

items.title: Negeri Sembilan exco lineup to be discussed with Zahid, finalised by Friday, says new MB
items.summary: SEREMBAN, Aug 2 — Newly sworn-in Negeri Sembilan Menteri Besar Datuk Ismail Lasim said today that the composition of the state executive council (exco) will be discussed with Umno president Datuk Seri Ahmad Zahid Hamidi before a final decision is made, with appointments expected by Friday. Speaking to reporters after taking his oath of office, Ismail said he would also seek the views of the Yang di-Pertuan Besar of Negeri Sembilan before the lineup is finalised. Mohd Zuhaimi and Mohd Aidil secured 506 votes and 2,816 votes, respectively.

items.title: Public holiday in Negri Sembilan tomorrow, MB announces
items.summary: SEREMBAN: A public holiday has been declared in Negri Sembilan tomorrow. Newly appointed Menteri Besar Datuk Ismail Lasim said the public holiday was a gesture of appreciation to the people following Saturday's state election. Also present was State Secretary Datuk Mohd Zafir Ibrahim.

items.title: Sri Lanka deploys troops after prison riot
items.summary: COLOMBO: Sri Lanka deployed hundreds of troops and elite commandos on Sunday to contain riots at an overcrowded prison in which an inmate was killed and six others wounded, police said. Deputy police inspector-general Sanjeewa Medawatte said the situation was under control after inmates destroyed multiple buildings on Saturday inside Mahara Prison, just outside the capital, Colombo. Medawatte said inmates at Mahara Prison had completely destroyed the kitchen, the hospital, a newly built rehabilitation building and vocational training facilities.

items.title: Tuanku Muhriz reminds Negri Sembilan assemblymen to put state, people before politics
items.summary: KUALA PILAH: The Yang di-Pertuan Besar of Negri Sembilan, Tuanku Muhriz Tuanku Munawir, today reminded state assemblymen to place the interests of the state and its people above political or personal considerations. His Royal Highness said every elected representative bears a heavy responsibility to bring the voices, aspirations, needs, and concerns of the people to the State Legislative Assembly. Accompanying His Royal Highness at the ceremony were Tunku Ampuan Besar Tuanku Aishah Rohani Tengku Besar Mahmud, Tunku Besar Seri Menanti Tunku Ali Redhauddin Tuanku Muhriz, and Tunku Panglima Besar Tunku Zain Al-'Abidin Tuanku Muhriz.

items.title: Steven Sim calls for self-reflection after Negri election, says every poll offers lessons
items.summary: BUKIT MERTAJAM: Penang DAP chairman Steven Sim described the Negri Sembilan election results as a timely reminder for the party to reflect, regroup and strengthen its strategy ahead of future political challenges. He said every election offered valuable lessons, but noted that DAP remained proud of retaining nine state seats, while Pakatan Harapan secured 11 seats overall in Negri Sembilan. "We thank the people of Negri Sembilan for taking part in the election and for exercising their democratic right to vote.

items.title: RXZ Members 8.0 roars to record 200,000 turnout
items.summary: KUALA NERUS: The RXZ Members 8.0 gathering made history by drawing more than 200,000 participants, the largest turnout since its inception in 2017. RXZ Members 8.0 organiser Mohamad Faizal Mat Ali said the turnout surpassed last year's record of 160,000 participants. Faizal said this year's gathering drew Yamaha RXZ fans from across the country, as well as participants from several neighbouring countries.

items.title: High Court stay on medicine price display order still in force, says MMA
items.summary: KUALA LUMPUR: The Malaysian Medical Association (MMA) has clarified that the High Court's stay on the enforcement of the medicine price display order against private clinics remains in force. The association said this follows reports of enforcement officers visiting private clinics in several states to request price lists, despite the stay on the Price Control and Anti-Profiteering (Price Marking for Drug) Order 2025. "No compound, prosecution or other enforcement action should be taken against private medical or dental practitioners for non-compliance with this order while the court proceedings are ongoing," said Malaysian Medical Association president Datuk Dr Thirunavukarasu Rajoo in a statement.

items.title: Aminuddin preparing to vacate Negri MB's official residence
items.summary: SEREMBAN: Datuk Seri Aminuddin Harun is preparing to vacate the Negri Sembilan menteri besar's official residence following his defeat in last night's state election. Barisan Nasional and Perikatan Nasional won a combined 25 seats yesterday, allowing both coalitions to form the state government with a two-thirds majority. Earlier today, BN's Juasseh assemblyman Datuk Ismail Lasim was sworn in as the new Negri Sembilan menteri besar.

items.title: Police probe viral Pandamaran car park brawl involving 16-year-old student
items.summary: SHAH ALAM, Aug 2 — Police are investigating a viral video on social media showing a brawl at the Pandamaran Sports Complex car park in Klang last Friday. Klang Selatan police chief ACP Lim Jit Huey said the incident occurred at approximately 1.20pm involving two men, one of whom is a 16-year-old student. Lim urged anyone with information on the incident to come forward and contact the investigating officer, Insp Mohammad Baaz Mohd Zohari, at 016-4117885, the Klang Selatan IPD operations room at 03-3376 2222, or any nearby police station.

items.title: Elderly man braves three-hour journey to fulfil wife's wish to visit Karnival Jom Heboh Sarawak
items.summary: KOTA SAMARAHAN: An elderly man braved a three-hour journey from Maludam to bring his family to Karnival Jom Heboh Sarawak Segulai Sejalai here today, fulfilling his wife's long-cherished dream. Untong Mahidin, 69, travelled from Betong with his wife, Alawiyah Jon, 67, and their two children, aged 24 and 35, so she could experience the carnival's vibrant atmosphere firsthand. "We came to Kota Samarahan solely to see Jom Heboh.

items.title: Lawyers group urges police to probe Rocky's death under Animal Welfare Act
items.summary: KUALA LUMPUR: Lawyers for Animal Rights (LFAR) has urged police to investigate the death of a dog known as Rocky under the Animal Welfare Act 2015 instead of the Penal Code, arguing that the case concerns animal cruelty rather than damage to property. "Parliament enacted the Animal Welfare Act 2015 specifically to address such cases, namely Section 29, which criminalises the infliction of unnecessary pain or suffering, and Section 30, which prohibits the killing of an animal except under specific statutory exceptions," he said in a statement today. Rajesh urged police to publicly explain why the investigation was not being conducted under the Animal Welfare Act, adding that the involvement of local council enforcement officers during a stray dog capture operation did not make any alleged act of cruelty lawful.

items.title: Ismail: Appointment as MB is a huge responsibility
items.summary: KUALA PILAH: New Negri Sembilan Menteri Besar Datuk Ismail Lasim says his appointment is a huge responsibility. Also present at the ceremony at Istana Besar Seri Menanti were Tunku Ampuan Besar Negri Sembilan Tuanku Aishah Rohani Tengku Besar Mahmud, Tunku Besar Seri Menanti Tunku Ali Redhauddin and Tunku Panglima Besar Tunku Zain Al'Abidin. Others in attendance included Undang Luak Sungei Ujong Datuk Muhammad Faris Johari and Undang Luak Rembau Datuk Hassan Ab Hamid, along with Barisan Nasional deputy chairman Datuk Seri Mohamad Hasan and Negri Sembilan elected representatives.

items.title: Tuanku Muhriz tells Negeri Sembilan assemblymen to put people above politics
items.summary: KUALA PILAH, Aug 2 — The Yang Dipertuan Besar of Negeri Sembilan, Tuanku Muhriz Tuanku Munawir, today reminded members of the State Legislative Assembly to always place the interests of the state and its people above political or personal considerations in carrying out the mandate entrusted to them. His Royal Highness said every elected representative bears a significant responsibility, as they are entrusted with bringing the voices, aspirations, needs, and concerns of the people to the State Legislative Assembly. Tuanku Muhriz stressed that every policy, plan, and decision made should reflect those aspirations and remain firmly focused on the welfare of the people and the continued development of Negeri Sembilan.

items.title: Who is Negri Sembilan's new Menteri Besar, Datuk Ismail Lasim?
items.summary: Ismail, 67, succeeds Datuk Seri Aminuddin Harun after Barisan Nasional, with the support of Perikatan Nasional, secured a majority of 25 seats in the 36-seat state assembly to form the new state government. A long-serving Umno leader, Ismail has represented Juasseh since 1999, making him one of the longest-serving assemblymen in the state. He previously served as the state Umno liaison committee treasurer and was also the former deputy chief of Negri Sembilan Umno Youth.

items.title: Only one-third of Malaysia-US exports face new tariff
items.summary: KUALA LUMPUR: Only about one-third of Malaysia's exports to the United States will be subject to the new 10 per cent tariff under the US Trade Representative's (USTR) latest Section 301 action, according to CIMB Securities Sdn Bhd. The firm estimated that 31.9 per cent of Malaysia's exports to the US will be subject to the Section 301 tariff, down from 33 per cent under the previous Section 122 regime. CIMB Securities said this would move an estimated RM3.3 billion of Malaysian exports out of the tariff's scope and lower the trade-weighted effective tariff rate to 5.1 per cent from 5.2 per cent.

items.title: BN will deliver responsible and people-centred govt in Negeri Sembilan, says Zambry
items.summary: SEREMBAN, Aug 2 — Barisan Nasional (BN) secretary-general Datuk Seri Zambry Abd Kadir said the mandate entrusted to the coalition by voters in the 16th Negeri Sembilan state election would be translated into a responsible, people-centred administration anchored on stability, integrity, and the state’s continued development. Zambry also thanked party members, campaign workers, election machinery, volunteers, and supporters whose dedication contributed to BN’s performance in the state election. The Negeri Sembilan State Legislative Assembly was dissolved on June 5 after the state BN withdrew its support for the leadership of Menteri Besar Datuk Seri Aminuddin Harun on April 27, triggering the state election For the latest news on the 16th Negeri Sembilan state election, visit https://prn.bernama.com/n9.

items.title: Message from voters clear, we'll work hard to regain support, says DAP
items.summary: KUALA LUMPUR: DAP has pledged to rebuild and move forward after accepting the outcome of the Negri Sembilan election, acknowledging that voters had sent a clear message to the party. DAP national chairman Gobind Singh Deo said the party accepted the result with humility and thanked voters who supported Pakatan Harapan and DAP, as well as its candidates, members, volunteers and campaign workers. Gobind also acknowledged the defeat of DAP secretary-general Anthony Loke in Chennah following a closely fought contest.

items.title: AI keeps consumer prices high in 'RAMaggedon' chip crunch
items.summary: HONG KONG: Print-outs of articles about the global memory chip shortage are pinned beside a price list at a Hong Kong computer shop, offering an explanation to confused customers feeling the pinch. It is caused as profit-hungry chipmakers pivot to producing high-bandwidth memory (HBM) - a more advanced type of computer memory in huge demand to help train and run AI tools. Ken Tam, manager of Videocom Computer, which specialises in custom-built PCs, said business has halved since price rises began in September.

items.title: Who is Ismail Lasim, the new Negeri Sembilan menteri besar?
items.summary: KUALA LUMPUR, Aug 2 — Datuk Ismail Lasim has been officially sworn in as the new menteri besar of Negeri Sembilan before the Yang di-Pertuan Besar of Negeri Sembilan, Tuanku Muhriz Tuanku Munawir. The ceremony marks a major transition in the state’s leadership, elevating a veteran politician and legal practitioner to the top executive office after more than two decades of public service in state administration. Ismail’s rise to the state’s highest political office comes as a continuation of his long-standing presence in Negeri Sembilan politics.

items.title: Police hunt suspects involved in public brawl at Pandamaran sports complex
items.summary: KLANG: Police are tracking down several people following a public brawl involving a 16-year-old schoolboy at the Pandamaran Sports Complex here. South Klang district police chief Assistant Commissioner Lim Jit Huey said police detected a video uploaded on Facebook showing two males fighting while being watched by a group of men. Lim said the South Klang district Criminal Investigation Department had opened an investigation paper under Section 160 of the Penal Code for committing an affray.

items.title: BN's win a mandate to revitalise Negri, says Azalina
items.summary: KUALA LUMPUR: Barisan Nasional's victory in the Negri Sembilan election is a mandate to revitalise the state, said Datuk Seri Azalina Othman Said. "The political understanding between BN and Perikatan Nasional in Negeri Sembilan was also one of the key foundations of this success," she said in a statement. Azalina also said that successful campaigns required more than traditional ceramah, posters and party machinery.

items.title: Ismail Lasim sworn in as new Negri Sembilan Menteri Besar [WATCH]
items.summary: SEREMBAN: Juasseh assemblyman Datuk Ismail Lasim has been sworn in as the 12th Menteri Besar of Negri Sembilan. Barisan Nasional deputy chairman Datuk Seri Mohamad Hasan and other state elected representatives were also present. Ismail was among several names previously shortlisted by BN for the state's top post, alongside Negri Sembilan Umno chairman and Pertang assemblyman Datuk Seri Jalaluddin Alias, Lenggeng assemblyman Datuk Mohd Asna Amin and Johol assemblyman Datuk Saiful Yazan Sulaiman.

items.title: It’s official: Ismail Lasim takes over as Negeri Sembilan menteri besar
items.summary: KUALA PILAH, Aug 2 — Juasseh State Assemblyman Datuk Ismail Lasim was today sworn in as the new Menteri Besar of Negeri Sembilan. Barisan Nasional (BN) deputy chairman Datuk Seri Mohamad Hasan and other state elected representatives were also present. In the 15th Negeri Sembilan state election, PH won 17 state seats, followed by BN (14) and PN (five), leading to the formation of a PH-BN state government.

items.title: Ismail Lasim set to become Negri Sembilan MB?
items.summary: KUALA PILAH: Juasseh assemblyman Datuk Ismail Lasim is expected to be sworn in as the new Negri Sembilan Menteri Besar today following Barisan Nasional's victory in the state election. Sources said Ismail was among several names submitted by BN for consideration, alongside state Umno liaison committee chairman Datuk Seri Jalaluddin Alias, Lenggeng assemblyman Datuk Mohd Asna Amin and Johol assemblyman Datuk Saiful Yazan Sulaiman. Ismail, 63, retained the Juasseh seat in the 16th Negri Sembilan election, defeating Bersatu's Mohd Zuhaimi Md Yusof and Pakatan Harapan's Mohd Aidil Abdullah with a majority of 4,323 votes.

items.title: Don't repeat past mistakes, Asyraf tells Umno after Negri win
items.summary: KUALA LUMPUR: Umno secretary-general Datuk Dr Asyraf Wajdi Dusuki has called on party members and supporters to remain humble following Barisan Nasional's victory in the Negri Sembilan election, urging them not to repeat past mistakes of arrogance after securing the people's mandate. "Do not repeat past mistakes. His remarks came after BN, led by Umno, emerged as the biggest winner in the Negri Sembilan election, securing 18 seats, including 16 won by Umno.

items.title: Ismail Lasim among three tipped for Negeri Sembilan menteri besar post
items.summary: SEREMBAN, Aug 2 — Kuala Pilah Umno chief Datuk Ismail Lasim is among three candidates tipped to be appointed as Negeri Sembilan’s new Menteri Besar. Ismail, 67, who is also a member of the Umno Supreme Council, won the Juasseh state seat in yesterday’s 16th Negeri Sembilan state election. The two other names being floated are Datuk Seri Jalaluddin Alias, 62, the Negeri Sembilan Umno liaison chairman and Jelebu MP who retained the Pertang state seat, and Datuk Mohd Asna Amin, 47, the former state deputy speaker who won the Lenggeng seat.

items.title: Selangor Veterinary Department probes viral dog abuse incident in Port Klang
items.summary: SHAH ALAM, Aug 2 — The Selangor Department of Veterinary Services (JPV Selangor) has launched a criminal investigation after a video showing a group of individuals restraining and dragging a dog by its neck went viral, culminating in the animal’s death. According to the department, multiple complaints were lodged through the MyAnimalWelfare system at around 9.25pm on 30 July 2026 after the video began circulating online. On 31 July, at about 11am, JPV Selangor’s Animal Welfare Team received the carcass of a male dog — believed to be the same animal seen in the video — along with an orange icebox from a local woman who surrendered the remains.

items.title: Negeri Sembilan to swear In new menteri besar this morning, chosen candidate still unknown
items.summary: KUALA PILAH, Aug 2 — Negeri Sembilan will install its new menteri besar this morning, with the swearing‑in ceremony scheduled to take place at the Balairung Seri, Istana Besar Seri Menanti at 10.15am, according to a media notice shared via WhatsApp. Barisan Nasional (BN) chairman Datuk Seri Ahmad Zahid Hamidi said he submitted three names to the Yang di‑Pertuan Besar during an audience at Istana Hinggap last night, stressing that the choice rests entirely with the ruler. The swearing‑in follows the outcome of the 16th Negeri Sembilan state election, where BN won 18 seats, Pakatan Harapan (PH) secured 11, and Perikatan Nasional (PN) took seven.

items.title: Man drowns after saving eight-year-old great-nephew from Terengganu river
items.summary: Hulu Terengganu police chief Supt Sharudin Abdul Wahab said firefighters recovered the body of Harun Ibrahim from the riverbank at about 7.30 pm, about 100 metres from the spot where he was reported missing. “The victim was eventually found on the riverbank by the Malaysia Fire and Rescue Department’s Water Rescue Team after the water level dropped during the search and rescue operation. Police advise the public to remain vigilant and exercise caution when visiting water recreation areas, given the recent spell of unpredictable weather,” he said.

items.title: After viral video shows young girl being molested, Sungai Buloh police searching for perpetrator
items.summary: KUALA LUMPUR, Aug 2 — Police are tracking down a foreign man suspected of molesting an 11-year-old girl at a business premises in Sungai Buloh, Selangor, on Wednesday (July 29). Sungai Buloh police chief Supt Mohd Hafiz Muhammad Nor said they received a report from the Kampung Baru Subang police station regarding the incident. He urged those with information regarding the case to contact the investigation officer, Insp Muhammad Amirul Amin Shukor, at 013-6695290 or the nearest police station.

items.title: Negeri Sembilan state election sees 30 candidates losing their deposits
items.summary: KUALA LUMPUR, Aug 2 — A total of 30 candidates lost their deposits after failing to garner at least one-eighth of the total of votes counted in the 16th Negeri Sembilan state election. Parti Pribumi Bersatu Malaysia (Bersatu), which did not win a single seat and failed to defend its Labu seat, suffered the biggest loss, with 23 out of 24 of its candidates losing their deposits. Also, the sole candidate from Parti Orang Asli Malaysia (ASLI) and Parti Sosialis Malaysia (PSM) both lost their deposit, along with one Pakatan Harapan (PH) candidate, and four independent candidates.

items.title: Out of nine women candidates in Negeri Sembilan polls, only three winners
items.summary: KUALA LUMPUR, Aug 2 — Only three of nine women candidates who contested in the Negeri Sembilan state election prevailed over their opponents, according to the Election Commission’s (EC) official results. S Leza (6,830 votes) won by a majority of 730 votes against PH candidate Datuk Noorzunita Begum (6,100 votes), while Siti Nur Umaira (14,209 votes) won by a majority of 5,279 votes against PH candidate Ahmad Faez Abdul Razak (8,930 votes) and Bersatu’s Mohamad Hanifah Abu Baker (1,985 votes). Meanwhile, Nicole Tan defended her Bukit Kepayang seat with a majority of 15,207 votes by polling 24,096 votes against PN’s Lee Boon Shian, who garnered 8,889 votes.

items.title: Both youngest and oldest winning Negeri Sembilan state election winners from Umno
items.summary: Siti Nur Umaira, the Rasah Umno Puteri division chief, secured 14,209 votes to win the seat with a majority of 5,279 votes, defeating Pakatan Harapan (PH) candidate Ahmad Faez Abdul Razak (8,930 votes) and Bersatu incumbent Mohamad Hanifah Abu Baker (1,985 votes). Meanwhile, Mohamad retained the Rantau state seat by securing 19,050 votes to defeat PH’s Dr Azizul Hakim Mahdi (7,032 votes) in a straight fight. He polled 32,004 votes in a three-cornered fight, defeating PH’s Ahmad Shahir Mohd Shah (15,045 votes) and Bersatu’s Mohd Nazree Mohd Yunus (2,205 votes).

items.title: Selangor to review stray animal management SOPs across all local authorities
items.summary: SHAH ALAM, Aug 2 — The Selangor state government will review the standard operating procedures (SOPs) for managing stray animals across all local authorities to ensure enforcement operations are carried out more effectively, safely and humanely. “The state government remains committed to safeguarding public safety, while at the same time enhancing animal welfare practices and upholding public trust in the integrity and professionalism of government agencies,” he said in a statement yesterday. Ng said the state government also expressed its appreciation for the advice of Tengku Permaisuri of Selangor, Tengku Permaisuri Norashikin, who emphasised the importance of compassion towards animals and the principle that no one is above the law.

items.title: Pakatan leaders vow collective responsibility for Negeri Sembilan loss, pledge continued commitment to constituents
items.summary: SEREMBAN, Aug 2 — All Pakatan Harapan (PH) leaders will take collective responsibility for the coalition’s defeat in the Negeri Sembilan state election, PH election director Datuk Seri Amirudin Shari said last night. He said the coalition’s leadership, from the highest level down to the grassroots, would shoulder responsibility collectively, stressing that no individual, group, community or faction would be singled out for blame. According to unofficial results, PH has garnered 11 of 36 seats it contested in the election, while Barisan Nasional (BN) and Perikatan Nasional (PN) secured 18 and seven seats respectively.

items.title: Zahid: BN submits three names for Negeri Sembilan menteri besar post
items.summary: SEREMBAN, Aug 2 — Barisan Nasional (BN) chairman Datuk Seri Ahmad Zahid Hamidi said that the coalition has submitted three names of candidates for the position of Menteri Besar to the Yang Dipertuan Besar of Negeri Sembilan, Tuanku Muhriz Tuanku Munawir. The Umno president said he delivered the official letter during an audience with Tuanku Muhriz at Istana Hinggap here tonight. Earlier, Tuanku Muhriz granted an audience to Ahmad Zahid at approximately 10 pm.

items.title: PM Anwar pledges continued cooperation, federal support for Negeri Sembilan government
items.summary: KUALA LUMPUR, Aug 2 — Prime Minister Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim said the federal government will continue to extend its support and cooperation to the new Negeri Sembilan state government for the well-being and prosperity of the state and its people. Earlier, BN chairman Datuk Seri Dr Ahmad Zahid Hamidi announced that BN and Perikatan Nasional (PN) would form the Negeri Sembilan state government after securing a two-thirds majority win in the state polls. The Negeri Sembilan State Legislative Assembly has 36 seats.

items.title: Seismic shift in Malaysian politics as BN-Perikatan ousts Pakatan heavyweights in Negeri Sembilan poll
items.summary: KUALA LUMPUR, Aug 2 — Negeri Sembilan woke up to a transformed political landscape this morning after voters decisively handed control of the state to a Barisan Nasional (BN) and Perikatan Nasional (PN) alliance. The outcome effectively toppled the Pakatan Harapan (PH) administration and unseated two of the coalition’s most powerful figures: DAP secretary-general Anthony Loke and caretaker Menteri Besar Datuk Seri Aminuddin Harun. Unofficial data from the Election Commission (EC) indicated that BN emerged as the largest bloc with 18 seats, while PN took seven.

items.title: Pakatan blames ‘racial politics’ after defeat to BN-Perikatan pact in Negeri Sembilan
items.summary: SEREMBAN, Aug 1 — Pakatan Harapan (PH) has attributed its dismal performance in today’s Negeri Sembilan state election to "racial and identity politics," cautioning that such polarising tactics threaten to fracture the state’s multi-ethnic social fabric. The coalition’s Election Department confirmed that PH unofficially won in only 11 of the 36 seats contested. “This state election witnessed an extraordinary campaign of racial politics based almost entirely on identity, which has the potential to sow division within society and the state.

items.title: Zahid: BN and Perikatan will partner to establish Negeri Sembilan administration
items.summary: SEREMBAN, Aug 1 — Barisan Nasional (BN) and Perikatan Nasional (PN) will form the new Negeri Sembilan government after securing a two-thirds majority in today’s state election, based on unofficial results. BN chairman Datuk Seri Dr Ahmad Zahid Hamidi said the unofficial results showed BN had won 18 seats while PN secured seven, giving the two coalitions a combined majority to form the state administration. Ahmad Zahid said the new state government will be built on an understanding between BN and PN, while upholding the mandate given by the people.

items.title: A ride cut short: Homeward-bound varsity student dies on highway after RXZ 8.0 gathering in Gong Badak
items.summary: DUNGUN, Aug 1 — A private university student was killed when the motorcycle he was riding skidded at Kilometre 354 of the East Coast Expressway 2 (LPT2), near here, today. Dungun police chief Supt Nik Ab Halim Nik Mat said 22-year-old Muhammad Bakhtiar Mazlan, from Parit Raja, Batu Pahat, Johor, was confirmed dead at the scene due to severe head injuries. He said police received a call from members of the public regarding the incident involving a Honda Vario motorcycle at about 3pm.

items.title: Economy Ministry eyes pilot project as Malaysia’s ageing population threatens fiscal and care pressures
items.summary: JOHOR BAHRU, Aug 1 — The Economy Ministry is identifying a pilot project to address challenges arising from Malaysia’s ageing population, with plans to roll it out next year. Economy Minister Akmal Nasrullah Mohd Nasir said the ageing agenda had been designated as a key pillar under the 13th Malaysia Plan. He said planning for the second rolling plan for next year’s development expenditure would be structured to cover all segments, including initiatives to address population ageing.

items.title: Myvi and Saga collide near Kelantan school, 80-year-old woman dies, four others seriously injured
items.summary: KOTA BHARU, Aug 1 — An 80-year-old woman was killed while four others, including two drivers, were seriously injured in a two-car collision near Sekolah Kebangsaan (SK) Kedai Piah, Ketereh, here this afternoon. Ketereh Fire and Rescue Station operations commander Mohd Nazri Taib said firefighters arrived at the scene four minutes after receiving an emergency call at 3.25pm. “Four other victims aged between nine and 38, including both drivers, suffered serious injuries,” he said in a statement today.

items.title: Penang Port marks 70 years by giving back to those in need
items.summary: GEORGE TOWN, Aug 1 — The Penang Port Commission (SPPP) reaffirmed its commitment to ensuring that the benefits of port development reach all segments of society, particularly those in need, in line with the Malaysia Madani aspirations. Its chairman Datuk Yeoh Soon Hin said SPPP’s role over the past 70 years had extended beyond advancing the port sector to supporting community well-being through various welfare initiatives. “Today, under the spirit of Madani, we reaffirm our commitment to ensuring that the benefits of development reach all segments of society, especially those in need,” he said at a tea reception held in conjunction with SPPP’s 70th anniversary celebration and the launch of the Penang Port 2026 National Month Celebration here today.

items.title: A Paka R&R special? Terengganu police nab trio over alleged open sale of ketum water, one suspect just 16
items.summary: KUALA TERENGGANU, Aug 1 — Police have arrested three men to assist in investigations into the open sale of ketum water at the Paka Rest and Service (R&R) area yesterday. Terengganu police chief Datuk Mohd Khairi Khairuddin said the suspects, aged between 16 and 32, were arrested during an inspection at the Sultan Mizan Zainal Abidin Stadium (SSMZA) slip road area near Gong Badak in Kuala Nerus at 7.44pm. “Initial investigations found the ketum water is believed to have been brought into Terengganu for their use throughout their stay here.

items.title: Right after saying ‘I do’, this Gen Z bride in Negeri Sembilan says ‘I vote’
items.summary: SEREMBAN, Aug 1 — Amid the excitement of her wedding day, a bride made an unforgettable stop at a polling station, arriving in a striking red traditional bridal outfit to cast her ballot in the Negeri Sembilan state election. Marketing officer Noor Farzana Masnoor, 26, was accompanied by her husband, Luqman Adam Sudirman, 27, as she voted at the Sekolah Jenis Kebangsaan Tamil (SJKT) Ladang Kubang polling centre in Labu for the Labu constituency. — Bernama

items.title: (Unofficial) Negeri Sembilan polls: ‘PBN’ to form state govt, sets sights on Melaka next
items.summary: KUALA LUMPUR, Aug 1 — Barisan Nasional chairman Datuk Seri Ahmad Zahid has thanked voters and supporters for giving his coalition and Perikatan Nasional the mandate to form the next Negeri Sembilan state government. Umno secretary-general Datuk Seri Asyraf Wajdi Dusuki is claiming victory for the Barisan Nasional-Perikatan Nasional pact in the Negeri Sembilan, saying the two have unofficially secured 25 seats from the 36 being contested in today’s state election. Asyraf said the two will jointly form the next state government.

items.title: Counting begins for nearly 12,000 postal ballots as Negeri Sembilan polls enter final stretch
items.summary: SEREMBAN, Aug 1 — Postal vote counting for the 16th Negeri Sembilan state election began at 5pm today. Approximately 12,000 postal ballots are being counted. On 20 July, EC secretary Datuk Khairul Shahril Idrus said a total of 13,263 postal ballots had been issued to eligible voters for the state election.
